verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a SaaS marketing platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for event subscriptions. The items cover the Marketing Emails REST API (pull-based GET requests), simple post-send workflows, Salesforce sync and an MCP server. None of these is webhook delivery that a programmatic consumer can receive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
